name: UI：产业带种草链路-起点入参10字段验证
description: 验证产业带种草链路起点入参包含10个字段(item_id/seller_id/tao_cate/seed_image_url/template_1~6)，相比种草20205新增template_1~6

steps.description: 打开产业带种草链路详情

steps.expression: (() => { const t = document.body.innerText; const baseParams = ['item_id', 'seller_id', 'tao_cate', 'seed_image_url']; const templateParams = ['template_1', 'template_2']; const baseFound = baseParams.filter(p => t.includes(p)); const templateFound = templateParams.filter(p => t.includes(p)); return { baseCount: baseFound.length, baseTotal: baseParams.length, templateCount: templateFound.length, templateTotal: templateParams.length, allBasePresent: baseFound.length === baseParams.length, allTemplatePresent: templateFound.length === templateParams.length, totalFound: baseFound.length + templateFound.length }; })()
steps.description: 统计10个入参字段完整性
